name: clearrun
description: Open SDK, CLI and MCP client for ClearRun. Calls the hosted API at api.clearrun.net; scoring runs server side.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @clearrun/core-types && npm run build -w @clearrun/sdk && npm run build -w @clearrun/mcp && npm run build -w @clearrun/scoring && npm run build -w @clearrun/security && npm run build -w @clearrun/vendors && npm run build -w @clearrun/cli
scripts.test:sdk: npm run build -w @clearrun/core-types && npm run test -w @clearrun/sdk
scripts.test:cli: npm run build -w @clearrun/core-types && npm run build -w @clearrun/sdk && npm run test -w @clearrun/cli
scripts.test:mcp: npm run build -w @clearrun/core-types && npm run build -w @clearrun/sdk && npm run test -w @clearrun/mcp
scripts.test: npm run test:sdk && npm run test:cli && npm run test:mcp && npm run validate:schema
